title: Hypixel Skyblock [Simple]
description: This is a simple Hypixel Skyblock modpack. Pre-configured and lightweight.
body:
## ✨ Hypixel Skyblock (Simple) --- ### ⚠️ Regarding Firmament for 26.1 Firmament has not yet updated to 26.1 officially, therefore if you want to use it anyways, you can get a indev version on their Github [here](https://github.com/FirmamentMC/Firmament/actions/workflows/build.yml?query=branch%3Amc-26.1). **Q**: Why do you not include the indev version in your modpack?
**A**: I'm not allowed to publish mods (or versions of them) in my modpack that are currently not hosted on Modrinth, unless I get explicit permissions from the creator of the mod. --- This streamlined Hypixel Skyblock modpack delivers a **clean, minimal, and distraction-free** gameplay experience. Its goal is simple: **only the essentials, nothing unnecessary**, and a UI that stays out of your way while still giving you every important feature Skyblock players rely on. ### 🚀 Included Hypixel Mods - [Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap) - [SkyHanni](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyhanni) - [SkyOcean](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyocean) - [Aaron's Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/aaron-mod) - [Firmament](https://modrinth.com/mod/firmament) - [Skyblock Profile Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblock-profile-viewer) - [Scoreboard Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/scoreboard-overhaul) - [Reward Claim](https://modrinth.com/mod/reward-claim) ### 🌙 What This Pack Stands For A **lightweight**, **performance-friendly**, and **highly functional** setup. No cluttered screens. No overloaded HUDs. No visual noise. Just the **core tools**, presented with modern UX and smooth usability. Perfect for players who want the **power of essential Skyblock mods** while keeping the game looking **clean, stylish, and focused**. ----- ### 🔧 Optional Features (Disabled by Default) This modpack includes a small number of optional modules that remain **disabled by default**, but users may choose to enable them at their own discretion: - **Freecam** – Sometimes viewed as an unfair advantage in certain contexts, though opinions vary. It is included for convenience but **remains off by default**. - **Fadeless** – Removes the Minecraft fade-in screen to allow instant gameplay. While generally harmless, it modifies client behavior and is therefore **opt-in only**. Enabling any of these features is a **personal choice**, and users should ensure they comply with Hypixel’s rules and use them responsibly. > **Whoever wants to use them can simply enable the toggle for these in the Modrinth app.** ----- ### ⚠️ Notice This modpack is intended to be **Hypixel-safe** and includes only widely accepted Skyblock utility mods. However, **no modification is ever officially approved by Hypixel**, and the server’s rules may change at any time. By using this pack, you acknowledge that **all modifications are used at your own risk**, and neither the creators nor distributors of this pack take responsibility for any potential consequences.
